modules.title: Carry-on

carryon_allowance.value: Moana Economy and Mānava Premium: 1 bag of 10 kg (22 pounds) + 1 personal item of 3 kg (6.6pounds). Poerava Business: 1 bag of 12 kg (26.6 pounds) + 1 personal item of 3 kg.

personal_item.value: One personal item per passenger (handbag, small backpack, laptop bag, briefcase and similar), maximum 3 kg, which must fit under the seat in front of you.

infant.value: Infants (0-23 months) without a seat: one personal item of 3kg (6.6pounds).

weight_economy.value: 1 cabin bag up to 10 kg + 1 personal item (Moana Economy)

weight_business_first.value: 1 cabin bag up to 10 kg + 1 personal item (Poerava Business / Moana Premium)

modules.lede: Cabin bags are examined before boarding; a non-compliant bag must be checked in and charges may apply.

modules.title: Checked baggage

allowance.value: On flights operated by Air Tahiti Nui: Moana Economy 1 bag of 23 kg (50.7 pounds); Mānava Premium 2 bags of 23 kg; Poerava Business 2 bags of 32 kg (70.5 pounds). Club Tiare Silver and Gold members get 1 extra bag.

size_weight.value: Maximum 32 kg (about 70.5 pounds) per checked bag (heavier items go as cargo), and the sum of the 3 dimensions must be 158 cm / 62.2 inches or less, including pockets, wheels and handles.

infant.value: Infants (0-23 months) without a seat, all classes: 1 bag of 10 kg (22 pounds) + 1 cane stroller, baby cot or car seat.

extra_bag_fees.value: Extra bag, between Australia and USA, Canada, New Zealand, French Polynesia, Japan or Asia: AUD 120; between Australia and other destinations: AUD 200. Between French Polynesia and AU, NZ, USA, Canada or New Caledonia: XPF 8 000; and France: XPF 10 000; and other destinations: XPF 12 000. Different fees apply to flights departing from the United States and Canada.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each (Poerava Business)

piece_weight_first.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each (Poerava Business is top cabin)

modules.lede: If you booked directly with Air Tahiti Nui, your baggage allowance is shown on your electronic ticket.

phone_home_market.notes: Air Tahiti Nui Papeete office customer support line.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: Meals, drinks, 2 communications, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays under EU 261 / French DGAC.

rebooking_refund.value: Full ticket refund within 7 days or rebooking to final destination for delays >5 hours or cancellations.

compensation.value: EU 261 statutory compensation (€250 to €600) for cancellations or delays >3 hours at final destination.

fare_name.value: Moana Saver, Moana Flex, Moana Premium, Poerava Business

seat_selection_included.value: Included on Moana Flex, Premium, and Business; fee on Saver until check-in.

change_cancellation_policy.value: Saver non-refundable; Flex/Business allow free date changes or full refund.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Moana Economy, Moana Premium (extra legroom recliners), Poerava Business lie-flat suites (B787 Tahitian Dreamliner).

reserved_or_random.value: Free advance seat selection for Flex, Premium, and Business; fee or check-in assignment for Saver.

family_seating.value: Air Tahiti Nui automatically allocates seats together for families travelling with children under 12.
